title: Crystalized Sweet Mint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crystalized’s Sweet Mint delivers a cool and refreshing vape, blending crisp, garden-fresh Mint with a delicate sweetness that lingers on the palate. The smooth, herbaceous notes of Mint create a bright and uplifting inhale, while the subtle sweetness rounds off the exhale for a clean and breezy finish. Perfect for vapers who enjoy a minty flavour without overpowering intensity. With a versatile 50% VG / 50% PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crystalized is a UK-based e-liquid brand dedicated to crafting distinctive, flavourful vape juices with an emphasis on MTL vaping. Their 50/50 VG/PG shortfills deliver clean, bright, and consistent flavours, making them an excellent choice for everyday vaping.
